programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: IMT Hyderabad PGDM admissions page: 'Fee Structure for PGDM, PGDM (Finance) Batch 2027-2029 INR 16 Lakhs'; academic fee includes accommodation and mess charges. Instalment schedule not published on the page. Scholarships: 40% academic-fee waiver for CAT/XAT 90+ percentile or GMAT Focus 655+; 20% for all women candidates; TFW scheme.
programs.intakeNote: Not stated on the admissions page.
programs.placementNote: IMT Hyderabad Annual Report PGDM Batch 2023-2025 (linked from the institute's Placement Data page, hosted on Google Drive): 186 students, 153 placed, 24 not placed, 3 ineligible; highest domestic Rs 30,85,000; average domestic Rs 12,28,877.46; lowest Rs 7,55,000. Median not published. Signed by Director and Head - Corporate Relations; audit not stated.

selectionProcess.name: Online IMT common application (CAT 2026 / XAT 2027 / GMAT)
selectionProcess.detail: Eligibility: 3-year bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate; final-year students may apply. Application fee Rs 3,500.

selectionProcess.name: Document submission and offline interview process
selectionProcess.detail: IMT admission process starts 1st week of Feb 2027; results 3rd week of Mar 2027. Selection weights not published on the campus page.

keyDates.notes: Online common application open from September 2026; IMT admission process starts 1st week of Feb 2027; results 3rd week of Mar 2027; classes begin June 2027. GMAT official scores to IMT central admissions by 15 Jan 2027 (campus-specific applications by 31 Mar 2027).
